title: AgentResponse
description: Structured output from a business agent. No free-text-only outputs.

agent.description: Name of the agent that produced this response

success.description: Whether the operation succeeded (optional, for cancel/track)

error.description: Error message if success is false or operation failed

slots_to_fill.description: Slot names the orchestrator should collect before re-invoking (e.g. order_id)

tool_calls.description: Tool invocations performed by this agent
